params.message:
New public trends get their links once a day, judged from both sides

packages/pipeline/link-trends.mjs: for each public trend not yet judged, its ten
nearest neighbours by shared concepts, judged by the deepen model from its side, and
each proposed link judged again from the other side; only agreed links are written.
A trend is judged once (trend_link_runs), at most ten a run. Daily at 08:30 UTC in
ops/crontab, after the writer.
